messages.confirmSyncMetaLeadForms: Sync all Lead Ads forms on this page? New forms will be created disabled and need a Funnel assignment before accepting leads.
messages.syncMetaLeadFormsNeedConfig: Note: new forms start disabled — assign a Funnel and enable them before they accept leads.
messages.syncMetaPagesNoAccount: This page is not linked to an OAuth account. Use the list-level "Sync Pages" button instead — it lets you pick the OAuth account to sync from.
messages.syncMetaLeadFormsNoToken: This page has no access token yet. Click "Sync Pages" (top of the list) to pull pages and tokens from your Meta OAuth account first.

tooltips.name: Facebook Page display name (synced from Meta).
tooltips.pageId: Meta numeric page id. Discriminator for webhook routing.
tooltips.pageAccessToken: Long-lived Page Access Token. Encrypted at rest. Obtained automatically via OAuth user token and synced by 'Sync Pages'.
tooltips.isActive: Inactive pages are ignored by the webhook receiver and excluded from form sync.
tooltips.subscribedToLeadgen: True after Meta App is subscribed to leadgen field on this page (POST /{pageId}/subscribed_apps).
tooltips.oAuthAccount: OAuthAccount used to discover this page. Provider must be 'meta-leadads'.
tooltips.tenant: Derived from the first selected team via Tenant.baseUserTeam. Set automatically by the AssignTenantFromTeam hook — assign teams to populate this.
